steps.title: Gather required materials
steps.instruction: Verify that all items listed in the key resources table and the materials and equipment sections are available before starting the experiment.

steps.title: Prepare RNase‑free environment
steps.instruction: Work in an RNase‑free area; use RNase‑free certified consumables and decontaminate surfaces and tools with RNaseZap. Keep purified RNA on ice, process immediately, store short‑term at –20 °C (1–2 days) or long‑term at –80 °C.

steps.title: Culture cells to 80–90% confluency
steps.instruction: Grow adherent mouse adipocytes (or other mammalian cells) in 10‑cm or 15‑cm dishes until they reach 80–90 % confluency (≈1 week). Aim for 40–60 µg total RNA in lysate, which yields 1–5 µg ribosome‑protected fragment (RPF) RNA for library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare fresh buffers
steps.instruction: On the day of the experiment, prepare all required buffers (e.g., wash buffer, lysis buffer, S‑400 column wash buffer) with RNase/DNase‑free molecular‑grade water and reagents.

steps.title: Cycloheximide wash and lysate preparation
steps.instruction: Treat cells with cycloheximide, wash, lyse, and clarify lysate while keeping everything on ice.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells in a 10‑cm plate with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS containing 100 µg/mL cycloheximide (CHX); remove PBS quickly (for suspension cells, spin in PBS+CHX for ~3 min).
Add 400 µL ice‑cold lysis buffer to the plate, scrape cells into the buffer, and transfer to a fresh tube.
Homogenize by vortexing and/or passing the lysate through a 26‑gauge needle; incubate on ice 10 min (no probe sonication).
Clarify by centrifugation at 15,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new RNase‑free tube; keep on ice and proceed to digestion the same day (or flash‑freeze in liquid N₂ and store at –80 °C for up to 1 week).

steps.title: Equilibrate MicroSpin S‑400 HR columns
steps.instruction: Prepare S‑400 columns for monosome purification just before RNase I digestion.

substeps.instruction: Use one S‑400 HR column per 100 µL lysate (e.g., three columns for 300 µL lysate containing 60 µg RNA).
Remove cap and seal; wash each column with 500 µL S‑400 wash buffer, discarding flow‑through each time.
Perform six washes per column (total 3 mL buffer). Push air gently over the column top to speed flow; avoid bubbles.
On the final wash, leave ~15 % of the buffer volume above the resin bed.
Spin the column at 600 × g for 4 min; do not let the resin dry.

steps.title: Monosome isolation and acid phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Isolate monosomes on S‑400 columns, extract RPF RNA with acid phenol‑chloroform, and precipitate the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL RNase I digest dropwise onto each column (avoid pipetting onto column walls).
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 2 min; collect ~125 µL eluate from each column and combine eluates.
Add an equal volume of acid phenol:chloroform, vortex, and incubate 5 min at 20–25 °C.
Spin at >15,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C; carefully collect the aqueous phase.
To each aqueous sample add 1:10 volume of 3 M NaOAc (pH 5.2) and 2 µL glycogen (15 mg/mL).
Add 1 volume ice‑cold isopropanol, mix, and incubate at –20 °C for >2 h (crash out RNA).
Spin at >15,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Wash pellet with 500 µL ice‑cold 80 % ethanol, spin at >15,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Air‑dry pellet 5–10 min (do not over‑dry).
Resuspend in 15 µL nuclease‑free H₂O; measure concentration with a Nanodrop (use 1 µL).
Pause point: store purified RNA at –20 °C for up to 1 week or at –80 °C for longer term.

steps.title: Prepare streptavidin magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Wash and equilibrate streptavidin‑coated magnetic beads for rRNA depletion.

substeps.instruction: Vortex bead suspension at medium speed to resuspend.
Transfer 90 µL bead suspension per sample to a microcentrifuge tube; place on magnetic rack 1 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 80 µL depletion buffer (DB); place on rack 1 min, discard supernatant.
Add another 80 µL DB, mix by pipetting (do not return tube to rack).

steps.title: PAGE purification of ribosome‑protected fragments (RPFs)
steps.instruction: Size‑select 27–30 nt RPFs from a denaturing 15 % TBE‑urea gel.

substeps.instruction: Mix each RPF sample with 10 µL 2× TBE‑urea dye.
Prepare 20/100 oligo ladder: 1 µL ladder (0.1 µg/µL) + 19 µL nuclease‑free water + 20 µL 2× TBE‑urea dye.
Prepare RNA control marker: 1 µL 27 nt (10 µM) + 1 µL 30 nt (10 µM) + 18 µL nuclease‑free water.
Boil samples, ladder, and marker at 95 °C for 5 min; place on ice.
Prepare 800 mL 1× TBE buffer for electrophoresis.
Cast a 15 % TBE‑urea gel, rinse wells with 1× TBE, pre‑run 5 min at 180 V.
Load 10 µL ladder, 10 µL marker, and 20 µL each sample (10 µL per lane, two lanes per sample).
Run at 180 V for 65 min (until bromophenol blue reaches gel bottom).
Stain gel with 3 µL SYBR Gold + 30 mL 1× TBE on a shaker at 20–25 °C for 20 min.
Create a hole in a 0.5 mL tube with an 18‑gauge needle, place tube inside a 1.5 mL tube.
Excise the 27–30 nt region (using the 27 nt and 30 nt markers as guides) and place slices in the 0.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge >15,000 × g for 2 min to shred gel; discard the 0.5 mL tube.
Add to each tube: 400 µL nuclease‑free water, 40 µL 5 M ammonium acetate, 2 µL 10 % SDS, 1 µL RNase inhibitor (Superasin).
Rotate at 20–25 °C for 2 h.
Trim a 1 mL pipette tip, transfer gel slurry to a centrifugal filter, centrifuge 2,000 × g for 3 min.
Collect flow‑through, add 2 µL Glycoblue and 700 µL 100 % isopropanol; mix.
Incubate >2 h at –20 °C.
Spin at 15,000 × g, 4 °C for 20 min; discard supernatant.
Wash pellet with 500 µL ice‑cold 80 % ethanol, spin 15,000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min.
Air‑dry ~10 min; resuspend in 3.5 µL nuclease‑free water.
Pause point: store at –20 °C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: PAGE purification of cDNA
steps.instruction: Size‑select 85–105 nt cDNA fragments from a denaturing 10 % TBE‑urea gel.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL 2× TBE‑urea dye to each cDNA sample.
Prepare 20/100 oligo ladder as above (1 µL ladder + 19 µL water + 20 µL dye).
Boil at 95 °C for 5 min; place on ice.
Prepare 800 mL 1× TBE buffer.
Cast a 10 % TBE‑urea gel, rinse wells, pre‑run 5 min at 180 V.
Load 10 µL ladder or 20 µL sample per lane.
Run at 180 V for 65 min (until bromophenol blue reaches bottom).
Stain with 3 µL SYBR Gold + 30 mL 1× TBE at 20–25 °C for 20 min.
Create a hole in a 0.5 mL tube (18‑gauge needle) and place in a 1.5 mL tube.
Cut out the 85–105 nt band (visible or not) and transfer slices to the 0.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 2 min; discard the 0.5 mL tube.
Add to each tube: 400 µL nuclease‑free water, 40 µL 5 M ammonium acetate, 2 µL 10 % SDS.
Incubate in a thermomixer at 37 °C, 900 rpm for 2 h.
Trim a 1 mL pipette tip, transfer slurry to a 1.5 mL centrifugal filter, centrifuge 2,000 × g for 3 min.
Collect flow‑through, add 2 µL Glycoblue and 700 µL 100 % isopropanol; mix.
Incubate >2 h at –20 °C.
Centrifuge >12,000 × g (4 °C) for 20 min; discard supernatant.
Wash pellet with 500 µL ice‑cold 80 % ethanol, spin >12,000 × g (4 °C) for 10 min.
Air‑dry ~10 min; resuspend in 10 µL nuclease‑free water.
Pause point: store at –20 °C.

steps.title: PAGE purification of PCR products (dsDNA library)
steps.instruction: Extract the final 140–160 bp dsDNA library from an 8 % native polyacrylamide gel.

substeps.instruction: Add 6 µL 5× native TBE loading dye to each 25 µL PCR product.
Prepare 6 µL of a 100 bp–1 kb ladder.
Prepare 800 mL 1× TBE running buffer.
Cast an 8 % native TBE gel, rinse wells, pre‑run 5 min at 180 V.
Load 30 µL of each sample (15 µL per lane, two lanes) and 6 µL ladder in one lane.
Run at 200 V for 40 min.
Stain with 3 µL SYBR Gold + 10 mL 1× TBE at 20–25 °C for 20 min.
Create a hole in a 0.5 mL tube (18‑gauge needle) and place in a 1.5 mL tube.
Cut out the 140–160 bp band and transfer to the 0.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge 14,000 × g for 2 min; discard the 0.5 mL tube.
Add to each 1.5 mL tube: 400 µL nuclease‑free water, 40 µL 5 M ammonium acetate, 2 µL 10 % SDS.
Incubate on a thermomixer at 37 °C, 900 rpm for 2 h.
Trim a 1 mL pipette tip, transfer slurry to a 1.5 mL centrifugal filter, centrifuge 2,000 × g for 3 min.
Collect flow‑through, add 2 µL glycogen and 700 µL 100 % isopropanol; mix.
Incubate >2 h at –20 °C.
Centrifuge >12,000 × g (4 °C) for 20 min; discard supernatant.
Wash pellet with 500 µL ice‑cold 80 % ethanol, spin >12,000 × g (4 °C) for 10 min.
Air‑dry ~10 min; resuspend in 25 µL nuclease‑free water.
Measure concentration with Qubit dsDNA high‑sensitivity kit.
Submit samples for BioAnalyzer QC and sequencing.
Pause point: store at –20 °C.

description: This protocol outlines steps for differentiated mouse adipocytes, which are adherent, but the steps described here can be applied to other mammalian cell types including those grown in suspension. Before beginning the protocol, ensure that all materials listed in the “key resources table” and “materials and equipment” sections are ready to use. Executing this protocol in an RNase-free environment is critical for successful completion of sample extraction and library preparation. Make sure that all materials used are certified as RNase-free. We also suggest using an RNase decontamination solution such as RNaseZap to clean work spaces and tools before starting. Additionally, maintaining RNA stability is crucial. Therefore, purified RNA intermediates are recommended to be processed immediately and handled on ice. If long-term storage of RNA extracted for this protocol is required, they should be kept at −80°C, otherwise short-term storage for one to two days at −20°C is acceptable.
